_doc: Compiler gravity rules (bible §64). Confidence is a §18 evidence class, not a probability.

conditions: kind == moe
expert_mass / total_params is HIGH (>= ~0.9) -- this is the binding condition
experts_per_tok << experts (necessary, NOT sufficient)
sparse_active_path
rules.then: candidate native expert-gather (move only active experts, not the full inventory)
rules.reopen_if: active-byte reduction fails to move TPS because decode is kernel-bound not bandwidth-bound (A3B tps_caveat; Qwen3.8 same pattern)
rules.physical_rationale: O005: 8/128 experts/token, 3.353B active of 30.5B (11%). mlx specimen 29.3 TPS is ~dense — gather is the lever, not a smaller codec.
rules._evidence: INFERRED (A3B_RECON CLASSIFICATION.sparse_active_path = MOE-UNIVERSAL; census MEASURED on O005) | O003 (Kimi-VL, DeepSeek-V3-style router, 64 experts/6-top-k+2-shared) CONFIRMED via primitive_design_attempt: ratio_selected_over_full=0.1212 (12.12%% of full expert body moved per token), mlx SwitchGLU/SwitchLinear gather_mm confirmed. See receipts/odyssey-i/O003_NX_gather.json. POPULATION TRANSFER TEST (12 measured MoE bodies, see receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_GATHER_RULE_TRANSFER_TEST.json): transferred on 10 of 12 (4.6-13.5% active) and FAILED on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 32.8% active -- which has the SPARSEST top-k ratio in the population (10/512). Cause: the rule assumed the expert organ is most of the model. Refined law, validated to 0.04pp against independent tensor arithmetic: active_fraction = non_expert_fraction + expert_fraction*(k/E). Gather's ceiling is 1 - non_expert_fraction, so the binding condition is EXPERT MASS FRACTION (Kimi-K3 96.2%, GLM-4.5-Air 92.2%, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next only 68.5%), not k << E.

conditions: near-uniform routing
never_routed_experts == 0
route entropy close to max
rules.then: cold-expert compression N/A; per-expert uniform codec is ok
rules.reopen_if: a patient shows cold experts, popularity skew, or entropy << max (then routing-frequency allocation may apply)
rules.physical_rationale: A3B entropy 6.09/7.00 bits, 0 never-routed, top expert 1.42% share, top-16 mass 18%. No skew to exploit.
rules._evidence: MEASURED (A3B_RECON route_map specimen, short prompt set; A1 still required for a full corpus) | O003 comparison point (NOT a test -- 91 tokens << 1000 threshold): entropy 4.8318/6.0 (81% of max, vs O005's 87%), top16_mass 34% (vs O005's 18%) -- MEASURABLY MORE SKEWED than the origin patient even at this thin sample, though global cold_experts=0 matches. Per-layer cold experts range 12-24/64 despite 0 globally-cold -- local sparsity exists even where global does not. Worth a >=1000-token O003 route corpus before assuming near-uniform transfers.

conditions: router sensitivity high
rules.reopen_if: router ablation stays Doctor-stable after aggressive quant
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 example. O005 router is 0.03 GB and gates all expert selection — cheap to keep precise, expensive if it is wrong.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (bible §64) + O003 MEASURED test of the condition itself (condition FALSE for this patient -- router robust to realistic requantization; condition remains untested for any patient where it might be TRUE)

condition_measured.O003: FALSE (router round8 delta_hits=0/12; sensitive organs were embed/attn/expert/shared_expert at -1/12 each, not router) -- see receipts/odyssey-i/O003_ROUTER_SENSITIVITY_TEST.json

conditions: expert sensitivities heterogeneous
rules.reopen_if: per-expert Doctor sensitivity is flat across the inventory | O003 N=1v1 is suggestive but inconclusive under round8 -- needs a real per-expert sweep, not treated as a test yet
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64. Distinct from organ_inversion (gate vs down): this is expert-index heterogeneity inside the same organ.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (bible §64; O005 per-expert sensitivity UNKNOWN — A3) | O003 first thin data point (N=1 hot vs N=1 random expert, packet.routing.hot_set): zero-ablation shows a small gap (hot -1/12, random 0/12) but the REALISTIC round8 requantize shows ZERO difference (both 0/12) -- NOT sufficient sample to move confidence off HYPOTHESIS; a full per-expert-index sweep is needed. See receipts/odyssey-i/O003_SENSITIVITY.json per_expert_sensitivity.

conditions: route transition predictable
P(E_t | E_{t-1}) peaked
rules.then: candidate prefetch of the next hot expert set
rules.reopen_if: transitions are near-uniform (A1 on O005 may confirm or kill)
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 / §57. Frequency being uniform does not imply transitions are memoryless.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (bible §64; O005 P(E_t|E_t-1) UNKNOWN — A1) | O003 MEASURED: transition_stability=0.4049 (4.32x chance 0.0938), p_e_t_given_e_t_minus_1=0.3819 (4.07x chance), 2340 transition-events -- see receipts/odyssey-i/O003_ROUTE_PREDICTABILITY_TEST.json

conditions: mlp1 gate+up more Doctor-sensitive than mlp2 down
rules.then: allocate bits to gate/up first, spend slack on down
rules.reopen_if: a parent measures NO organ sensitivity split (gate and down degrade within 10 percent of each other)
rules.physical_rationale: Foundry V1/V2 organ_inversion: F0 gpt-oss-120b real forward; F1 qwen3-235b dominant_failure_organ=gate.
rules._evidence: INFERRED (GRAVITY_METHOD_REGISTRY organ_inversion; not yet measured on Odyssey patients)

conditions: routing frequency measured on >=1000 tokens
calibration corpus disjoint from scored holdout
routing is NOT near-uniform
rules.then: allocate rate by measured expert routing frequency
rules.reopen_if: near-uniform routing (then this rule is N/A — see R-uniform-routing-no-cold-compress). Never reopen the 88-token calibration.
rules.physical_rationale: Foundry prior is alive, but 88-token calibration is dead (median split 63.6% stable, 26.1% of cells never route). O005 specimen is near-uniform so this rule is currently negative on O005.
rules._evidence: HYPOTHESIS (registry alive; atlas killed 88-token calibration; O005 specimen argues N/A) | O003's 91-token route sample shows real skew (top16_mass 34% vs O005's 18%, per-layer cold experts 12-24/64) that would argue for this rule's applicability IF the sample met its own >=1000 token precondition -- it does not (91 tokens), so this remains NOT_TESTED, not confirmed. A real O003 route corpus is the next concrete acquisition step for this rule.

conditions: layer-0 non-Gaussianity or Shannon-gap >> mid/late layers
rules.then: do not treat all layers as one coding problem; per-layer codec selector
rules.reopen_if: patient measures flat layer-wise source statistics
rules.physical_rationale: qwen3-235b layer 0 is a different source. post_attention_layernorm gamma^2 anisotropy predicts it data-free.

conditions: affine grouped q2 is Doctor-valid
native decode kernel exists
rules.reopen_if: Doctor-valid q2 without a native kernel (foreign-runtime gate) or a native kernel that is not Doctor-valid
rules.physical_rationale: bible §64 example. Wrapper TPS is not a Hawking win (§60 foreign-runtime).

rules.title: SSM/recurrent state is a constant cache; attention KV grows -- crossover = state/kv-per-tok
rules.claim: Recurrent-state organs (Mamba/SSM, linear/delta attention) hold a CONSTANT cache independent of context length; full-attention organs hold a KV cache that grows linearly. Resident-memory crossover = state_bytes_constant / kv_bytes_per_token. Below it the SSM state floor dominates; above it KV dominates. The hybrid layer ratio (n_attn : n_ssm), not model size, sets where the crossover falls.
rules._evidence: INFERRED from A5 multi-arch config accounting; see receipts/odyssey-i/O001_A5_SSM_RULE.json
conditions: architecture is hybrid or pure recurrent (Mamba/SSM, linear or delta attention)
the body mixes constant-size recurrent state with growing attention KV
context length is known or bounded
rules.then: compute the resident-memory crossover as state_bytes_constant / kv_bytes_per_token. Below it the constant SSM state floor dominates and weight-quant levers do not touch it; above it KV dominates and eviction/KV compression is the target. The hybrid layer ratio (n_attn : n_ssm), not model size, sets where the crossover falls.
rules.reopen_if: a hybrid body is found whose recurrent state is NOT context-independent, or where measured resident memory diverges from the crossover this predicts
rules.physical_rationale: Recurrent-state organs (Mamba/SSM, linear/delta attention) hold a CONSTANT cache independent of context length; full-attention organs hold a KV cache that grows linearly. Resident-memory crossover = state_bytes_constant / kv_bytes_per_token. Below it the SSM state floor dominates; above it KV dominates. The hybrid layer ratio (n_attn : n_ssm), not model size, sets where the crossover falls.
rules._schema_note: normalised into the rulebase's own conditions/then/confidence schema. It was authored with title/claim/family/origin instead, so any consumer iterating rule['conditions'] raised KeyError on this one entry -- found by exactly that crash. Original fields retained; nothing dropped.

conditions: kind == moe
target uniform bit-level is aggressive (measured: q2, near-catastrophic if applied uniformly)
a high-redundancy organ exists that dominates param count (MoE experts: ~95% of weights, individually low marginal value)
rules.then: target the high-redundancy organ (experts) at the aggressive bit-level; protect the small structurally load-bearing organs (attn/router/embed/lm_head) at a safer level (measured: one tier up, e.g. 4-bit if experts go to 2-bit)
negative_patients: O001 (architecture-mismatch: hybrid SSM+attention, NOT MoE -- the same strategy applied to attn+mlp shows no benefit and is worse in mixed configs)
rules.reopen_if: a future MoE patient shows the gain vanish or reverse at q2, or a non-MoE patient with a genuinely low-marginal-value redundant organ (not attn/mlp) shows the same rescue effect
rules.physical_rationale: O006: q2 uniform 0/12 -> q2-experts-only 10/12 for +0.07 bpw (2.95->3.02). O005: q2 uniform 0/12 -> q2-experts-only 11/12 for +0.08 bpw (3.00->3.08). Vanishes by q3+ (uniform already survivable). O001 (non-MoE) shows the identical strategic move gives NO benefit and is worse in mixed schemes -- the redundancy MoE experts offer (many near-interchangeable low-marginal-value units) has no equivalent in attn+mlp.
rules._evidence: MEASURED (O006, O005 Gravity receipts, existing on disk) + negative control MEASURED (O001)

conditions: config declares tied embeddings/head
CHECK whether a separate head tensor physically exists -- roughly half of surveyed checkpoints ship one and half do not
rules.then: verify the tie is genuine with a full byte-exact tensor comparison (not shape-only), then reclaim the duplicate lm_head.weight from stored bytes -- alias/reference it to embed_tokens.weight at load/pack time instead of storing a second physical copy. Zero capability cost: this is exact redundancy elimination, not a quantization tradeoff, so it does not compete for the same error budget as any Gravity codec search.
discovery_phase_evidence: CAND-iLLaDA-8B (GSAI-ML/iLLaDA-8B-Base): tie_word_embeddings=true, lm_head.weight present as a separate on-disk tensor in shard 4, full-tensor SHA256 verified IDENTICAL to embed_tokens.weight in shard 1 (not just matching shape) -- 1212.0 MiB (0.635B params) duplicated for one logical weight, 7.55%% of the checkpoint stored bytes. See receipts/odyssey-i/CAND_iLLaDA-8B_ODYSSEY_I.json.

CAND-Qwen3-0.6B (Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B): SECOND independent confirmation, unrelated model family (Qwen vs GSAI-ML/LLaDA) -- tie_word_embeddings=true, lm_head.weight present as a separate on-disk tensor, full-tensor SHA256 verified IDENTICAL to embed_tokens.weight. 155.6 MiB (0.156B params) duplicated, 10.9%% of checkpoint stored bytes. Also independently reconciles the SAME raw-vs-name gap mechanism as iLLaDA: raw stored params were 25.27%% over the 0.6B name, deduplicating brings it to 0.66%%. See receipts/odyssey-i/CAND_Qwen3-0.6B_ODYSSEY_I.json.

CAND-pi0_base and CAND-ModernBERT-large: BOTH declare tie_word_embeddings/tied heads and BOTH store the tied matrix ONCE (no separate head tensor exists in either checkpoint) -- the CLEAN counter-examples.

SMALL-BODY COHORT (tests 5-8): LFM2.5-2.6B-Base and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B are CLEAN (tied, stored once); Falcon3-1B-Instruct and LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct are NOT TIED at all. Campaign tally now 8 specimens: 2 wasteful, 4 clean, 2 untied. See receipts/odyssey-i/CAND_SMALL_BODY_COHORT_ODYSSEY_I.json.
rules.reopen_if: a specimen with tie_word_embeddings=true is found where the on-disk tensors are NOT byte-identical (the flag would be vestigial there, the way Dream-v0s use_cache=true turned out to be vestigial this same session -- ALWAYS VERIFY, never trust the config flag alone) -- OR a loader/runtime is found that already dedups tied weights transparently, making this a known-solved problem rather than a live opportunity.
rules.physical_rationale: tie_word_embeddings is a common HF transformers setting (NOT specific to diffusion LMs -- Dream-v0 in the same census has the flag FALSE, so this is a general checkpoint-packaging question, not an architecture-family one). A checkpoint author may still ship a materialized lm_head.weight for loader compatibility with code that expects it as a distinct tensor, even though the two are logically one weight -- pure storage waste recoverable with zero risk to capability.
rules._evidence: DISCOVERY-PHASE ONLY (single candidate, not yet an admitted O0XX Odyssey patient) -- full byte-exact SHA256 verification, not a shape-only inference. Not yet added to TRANSFER_MATRIX.json (that instrument tracks the 14 formal O000-O013 curriculum patients; this finding has no O0XX support yet, so a matrix row would be unearned). Re-evaluate once a second tied-embedding specimen is discovered or one of O000-O013 is found to have the flag. UPDATE: now 2 independent specimens across 2 unrelated model families (GSAI-ML/LLaDA, Qwen) both confirm the wasteful-duplicate pattern, while pi0_base (also tied) stored its equivalent weight only once -- a real per-checkpoint choice, not universal either way, but no longer single-specimen evidence. Still discovery-phase only, no O0XX patient support, so still no TRANSFER_MATRIX row. FOURTH DATA POINT: the rule now stands at 4 tied-embedding specimens, 2 wasteful (iLLaDA-8B, Qwen3-0.6B -- verified byte-identical duplicates on disk) and 2 clean (pi0_base, ModernBERT-large -- stored once). That 2/2 split is the real finding: this is a per-checkpoint PACKAGING choice, not a family, framework or format property, so the config flag alone predicts NOTHING. The rule earns its keep entirely through its VERIFY step. DECISIVE WITHIN-VENDOR COUNTER-EXAMPLE: Qwen3-0.6B physically DUPLICATES its tied matrix (byte-identical lm_head, 10.9% of its checkpoint) while Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B -- same vendor, same 0.6B class, same qwen3 model_type -- stores it ONCE. Two checkpoints from one lab at one scale land on opposite sides, which forecloses any explanation by family, framework, format or scale. It is a per-export packaging accident. Confidence raised INFERRED -> MEASURED: the rule is now a measurement procedure with 8 data points, and its entire value is the verify step, because the config flag has zero predictive power.

conditions: body is a non-language-decoder specialist (vision / video / depth / audio / time-series)
measured parameter share shows one backbone/encoder >= 90% of total params
rules.then: do NOT spend search budget on organ-heterogeneity levers -- there is only one organ. Attack the backbone directly, and take the free bf16 cast first if the checkpoint ships F32.
discovery_phase_evidence: Measured this session across 5 specialist bodies: Depth-Anything-V2-L backbone 90.8%, SmolVLM2-2.2B model 95.5%, sam2.1-hiera-large vision_encoder 94.8%, vjepa2-vitg encoder 97.8%, timesfm-2.0-500m decoder 99.0%. All 5 also ship F32 while every decoder LM surveyed ships BF16/F16 -- 7 non-decoder-LM specimens now, all F32. See receipts/odyssey-i/CAND_SPECIALIST_COHORT_ODYSSEY_I.json and CAND_sam2.1-hiera-large_ODYSSEY_I.json.
rules.reopen_if: a specialist body is found whose parameters are NOT backbone-concentrated -- musicgen-large is the live candidate (three sub-models incl. a full audio codec) and could not be measured because it ships legacy pickle rather than safetensors. Also reopen if a bf16 cast is shown to cost capability on any of these, since the 'F32 is convention' half rests on zero capability measurement.
rules.physical_rationale: specialist heads are tiny by construction: a depth head is 0.1% of the body, a JEPA predictor 2.2%. Compressing them cannot move the total however aggressive the codec, so any budget spent there is wasted regardless of result.
rules._evidence: MEASURED per-component parameter shares from safetensors headers, 5 bodies, no GPU. DISCOVERY-PHASE ONLY: no O0XX patient support, so no TRANSFER_MATRIX row.

conditions: body is DENSE (no expert organ)
total params below ~1B
the EBPW ladder (<2.5) is the target
rules.then: do NOT spend a Gravity search expecting the ladder. Measure the ceiling first with a generous codec; if 8-bit grouped affine is already only ~0.98 top-1, the body has no redundancy to give and the achievable win is ~2-4x off bf16, not a ladder rung.
discovery_phase_evidence: MEASURED on Qwen3-0.6B across 28 configurations, four representation classes, with a verified-adequate magnitude-sensitive verifier (0.01xW rejected at 2550x perplexity, top-1 0.000). Best complete EBPW at top-1 >= 0.90 was 6.500; best at top-1 >= 0.70 was 4.250; NOTHING at or below 2.5 EBPW survived -- all collapsed 5-8 orders of magnitude in perplexity. See receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_GRAVITY_Qwen3-0.6B.json.
rules.reopen_if: a sub-1B DENSE body reaches <=2.5 complete EBPW at usable capability under any representation class, or a class not searched here (learned codebooks, structured sparsity, cross-layer bases, procedural generation) rescues one. Only four classes were searched and only one body was tested.
rules.physical_rationale: the ladder targets were earned on large MoE bodies where one organ holds ~95% of the mass and only a few percent of it fires per token -- enormous redundancy to spend. A 0.6B dense body is small precisely because its weights are load-bearing; there is nothing to give back.
rules._evidence: MEASURED, single dense patient, CPU. DISCOVERY-PHASE: no O0XX admission, so no TRANSFER_MATRIX row.

conditions: weight distribution has significant per-tensor outlier range
a quantisation budget is being chosen
rules.then: spend the first metadata on GROUPING before spending it on bit-width. Track local range with per-group scale+zero; per-tensor scaling on an outlier-heavy body is catastrophic at low bits.
discovery_phase_evidence: MEASURED on Qwen3-0.6B: per-tensor uniform at 4 bits gives perplexity 6,325,960x fp32 and top-1 0.000; per-GROUP affine at the SAME 4 bits gives 1.19x and top-1 0.748. Identical payload budget, roughly five-million-fold difference in damage.
rules.reopen_if: a body is found where per-tensor and per-group scaling perform comparably at low bits -- that would indicate a benign weight distribution and make the grouping metadata pure waste.
rules.physical_rationale: a single scale must span the tensor's extreme values, so a few outliers consume the entire code space and the bulk of the distribution collapses into one or two levels. Grouping bounds the range each scale must cover.
rules._evidence: MEASURED. Metadata cost is counted in the complete EBPW throughout, so the comparison is like-for-like: g16 buys top-1 0.820 but carries 2 bits/weight of metadata (33% of budget).

conditions: heterogeneous per-organ precision is being allocated
rules.then: rank organs by MEASURED sensitivity, never by mass. Also check for a FLOOR: a tolerant organ crushed too far can cap achievable quality no matter how many bits the others get.
discovery_phase_evidence: MEASURED on Qwen3-0.6B: MLP is the DOMINANT organ (44.3% of linear mass) and at 2 bits costs 2218x perplexity; the embedding organ (26.1%) at 2 bits costs 2.33x -- ~1000x apart at the same budget, with the dominant organ being the sensitive one. AND the floor: embeddings at 2 bits cap quality at ~1.95x perplexity / top-1 0.593 even with attention and MLP left at 8 bits.
rules.reopen_if: an organ ranking derived from mass matches one derived from measured sensitivity on any body -- so far they were inverted.
rules.physical_rationale: mass says how many bytes an organ holds, not how much the output depends on each of them. Those are independent quantities and this body shows them anti-correlated.
rules._evidence: MEASURED across 28 configurations with a verified-adequate verifier.

conditions: a STRUCTURAL representation class is being considered (low-rank, shared basis, codebook, hot/cold, sparse residual)
the target organ's top-k singular-value energy is within ~2x of a matched random Gaussian
rules.then: do NOT implement the structural class on that organ. It has no exploitable structure and will cost metadata for nothing. Spend the budget on bit-width, or on an organ with a higher ratio.
discovery_phase_evidence: MEASURED on Qwen3-0.6B. MLP tensors: top-64 SV energy 1.32-1.69x a matched random Gaussian, kurtosis 3.70-4.00 (Gaussian is exactly 3.0). Embedding/lm_head: 3.15x. TWO structural classes were then tested and BOTH failed on the MLP exactly as the ratio predicts -- hot/cold with 1/2/5% outlier channels preserved was WORSE than uniform at LOWER EBPW (top-1 0.5734 vs 0.7476 at 4.334 vs 4.500), and low-rank r64+3b was worse on both axes (4.648 / 0.5695). The same low-rank class on the higher-ratio embedding organ was merely NEUTRAL rather than harmful (4.502 / 0.7339), so the ratio ranks tolerance correctly. See receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_MLP_SENSITIVITY_MECHANISM.json.

STRENGTHENED by G028: hot/cold was then tested on ATTENTION, the organ with the heaviest tail in the body (q_proj kurtosis 6.76 against the MLP's 3.7-4.0), on the explicit expectation that it would pay. It did NOT -- hot 10% + cold 3b gives top-1 0.6419 at EBPW 4.573 against the control's 0.7476 at 4.500. Product/vector codebooks (dim 2 and 4, 256-entry, codebook counted) also failed: top-1 0.3992 and 0.0059. SEVEN classes now tested on this body and not one beats plain grouped affine at matched EBPW. The threshold is therefore not merely 'ratio <~2 fails' -- kurtosis 6.76 was also insufficient, so heavy-tailedness alone does not license an outlier-preserving class.
rules.reopen_if: a structural class pays on an organ whose spectral ratio is below ~2, or a ratio above ~3 produces a genuine WIN rather than the neutral result seen here -- the threshold is calibrated on ONE body and the embedding result shows 3.15x is still not sufficient.
rules.physical_rationale: structural compression classes all assume the information is concentrated -- in a few directions, a few channels, or a reusable dictionary. An organ whose spectrum matches random has its information spread uniformly across every weight, so any structural factorisation pays metadata to capture something that is not there.
rules._evidence: MEASURED with a matched random-matrix control, which is what makes the ratio meaningful rather than an absolute SV number that varies with shape.
